ProductService.title: ProductService
ProductService.description: Represents a product or service offered by the company, such as PCMSO or a clinical exam.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProductService entity.

name.description: Name of the product or service (e.g., PCMSO, Clinical Exam).

description.description: Detailed description of the product or service.

ServiceGroup.title: ServiceGroup
ServiceGroup.description: Represents a category for grouping services for reporting purposes (e.g., 'Exams', 'Engineering').

id.description: Unique identifier for the ServiceGroup entity.

name.description: Name of the service group (e.g., Exams, Engineering).

PriceTable.title: PriceTable
PriceTable.description: Represents a price table defining prices for clients or standard prices.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PriceTable entity.

clientId.description: Reference to Client. (Relationship: Client 1:N PriceTable). Nullable, indicates a standard price table if null.

isStandard.description: Indicates whether this is a standard price table applicable to all clients.

PriceTableItem.title: PriceTableItem
PriceTableItem.description: Represents an item within a price table, associating a product/service with a specific price.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PriceTableItem entity.

price.description: Price of the product/service in this price table.

ExamCost.title: ExamCost
ExamCost.description: Represents the cost of an exam from a credentialed network (purchase cost).

id.description: Unique identifier for the ExamCost entity.

CredentialedNetwork.title: CredentialedNetwork
CredentialedNetwork.description: Represents a clinic or partner network providing services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CredentialedNetwork entity.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Represents an invoice generated for a client.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invoice entity.

status.description: Status of the invoice (e.g., pending, paid, overdue).

InvoiceItem.title: InvoiceItem
InvoiceItem.description: Represents a single item on an invoice.

id.description: Unique identifier for the InvoiceItem entity.

ProviderInvoice.title: ProviderInvoice
ProviderInvoice.description: Represents an invoice received from a service provider (clinic/partner).

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProviderInvoice entity.

status.description: Status of the invoice (e.g., pending, paid, overdue).

ProviderInvoiceItem.title: ProviderInvoiceItem
ProviderInvoiceItem.description: Represents a single item on a provider invoice.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProviderInvoiceItem entity.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client of the company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the financial module's features while adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, QAPs, and Invariants.  It uses structural segregation to group data with similar security needs, and denormalization to avoid complex security rules that depend on hierarchical data. Path-based ownership is favored where applicable (e.g., client-owned data). The membership map pattern is not applicable in this scenario.

*   `/product_services`: Stores the products and services offered. This collection doesn't require special authorization beyond basic authenticated access, as it represents catalog data. 
*   `/service_groups`: Stores service groups for reporting. Similar to `product_services`, it mainly requires authenticated access. 
*   `/price_tables`: Stores price tables. To ensure QAPs, `clientId` is used as the document id if its a client specific price table. If its standard, then the document Id will be 'standard'.
*   `/price_tables/{priceTableId}/price_table_items`: Stores price table items for each price table.  Authorization depends on the parent price table (either client-owned or standard).
*   `/exam_costs`: Stores the cost of exams.  Requires authentication to access.
*   `/credentialed_networks`: Stores credentialed networks (clinics). Requires authentication to access.
*   `/clients/{clientId}/invoices`: Stores invoices for each client. Uses path-based ownership for clear authorization.  
*   `/clients/{clientId}/invoices/{invoiceId}/invoice_items`: Stores invoice items for each invoice. Authorization relies on path-based ownership and inherits authorization from the parent invoice.
*   `/credentialed_networks/{credentialedNetworkId}/provider_invoices`: Stores invoices from service providers. Uses path-based ownership for clear authorization.
*   `/credentialed_networks/{credentialedNetworkId}/provider_invoices/{providerInvoiceId}/provider_invoice_items`: Stores invoice items for each provider invoice. Authorization relies on path-based ownership and inherits authorization from the parent provider invoice.

This structure facilitates simple security rules based on path ownership.  For example, rules can easily grant a client read/write access to their own invoices and invoice items under `/clients/{clientId}`.  Similarly, credentialed networks can manage their own provider invoices and items.  The segregation of standard vs client specific `price_tables` supports QAPs, because rules can easily scope read access to standard price tables vs client-specific price tables.
